body: Mingyue Fastener Co., Ltd. is a fastener factory in Wenling, Taizhou, Zhejiang, China: 68 people on a 6,500 m² site, running cold heading, thread rolling, heat treatment and optical sorting in-house. Founded in 2009, IATF 16949 certified since 2023 [待确认：证书扫描件], exporting to 23 countries.

steps.title: Cold heading
steps.text: 14 multi-station cold headers, six of them four-die four-blow machines installed in 2022, form head and shank from coil wire.

steps.title: Thread rolling
steps.text: 20 thread rolling machines roll the thread after heading; rolling keeps the grain flow continuous and holds tolerance 6g.

steps.title: Heat treatment
steps.text: One mesh-belt furnace line on site hardens and tempers to class 10.9 and 12.9, so no batch leaves for an outside heat treater.

steps.title: Optical sorting
steps.text: Three automatic optical sorting machines inspect 100% of automotive parts; a spectrometer and a salt-spray chamber back up material and coating checks.
